messages.content: Hey, I just got out of the Q3 goal planning meeting. Man, I have to complain—that OKR review template in the spreadsheet was incredibly hard to format.
Welcome back! Ugh, fighting with spreadsheet formatting is the worst way to start a planning session. Did things smooth out after that?

Eventually. Boss Zhang mentioned he absolutely prefers having his morning coffee before starting the OKR review, so we had to wait for him to grab a cup. Then someone joked that the OKR review meetings always run 20 minutes over schedule anyway.
Classic office dynamics! Let me guess, it actually did run 20 minutes over?

Yep! We got sidetracked because we literally spent time discussing the font size used in the OKR review presentation deck. But we finally got to the core stuff. Today, July 7th, Boss Zhang made the final call during the OKR review that the multiplayer mode will be our top priority for Q3.
That's huge! Having multiplayer as the top priority gives the team a really clear focus for Q3. Are you excited to dive into the design for it?
I am! It's going to be a lot of work, but I'm glad we finally have a concrete direction. I'll start mapping out the initial gameplay loops tomorrow.
Sounds like a great plan. Just let me know if you need a sounding board when you start drafting those gameplay loops!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-07 Boss Zhang decided during the OKR review that the multiplayer mode will be the top priority for Q3.

messages.content: Hey, let's update my notes from the OKR review today. Since Boss Zhang made multiplayer our top priority for Q3, Wanghao and I had to figure out the technical breakdown.
You got it! What did you and Wanghao decide on for the technical goals?
Well, Wanghao concluded in the OKR review that the server latency must be reduced by 20 milliseconds. Honestly, he felt pretty tired after sitting through the entire OKR review.
Noted the 20ms latency reduction. And yeah, those marathon OKR meetings can be super draining. Did he set any capacity targets?
Yeah, he established the OKR review technical target of supporting 500 concurrent users per shard. After we finished, I promised Wanghao I would buy him lunch to celebrate surviving the OKR review.
500 concurrent users per shard is on the books. Lunch sounds like a well-deserved reward! Did you guys get to relax a bit?
A little bit. We mostly just chatted about the snacks provided during the OKR review break. The pastries were surprisingly good this time!
Hey, good snacks are half the battle in those meetings! I've saved Wanghao's technical targets for the Q3 push. Anything else you need to jot down?

golden_memories: On 2025-07-07 Wanghao concluded in the OKR review that the server latency must be reduced by 20 milliseconds.

messages.content: Hey, just got out of a meeting with Boss Zhang about the studio visit. He finalized the decision that I'll be leading the Shenzhen trip next month!
That's awesome news! Leading the trip is a big deal, especially with the multiplayer mode being top priority right now. How are you feeling about it?

Pretty excited, though I was wondering if the weather during the Shenzhen trip would be way too humid. I'm definitely going to need to buy a new suitcase for the Shenzhen trip, my old one is completely busted.
Shenzhen in August will definitely be hot and sticky, so pack light! A new suitcase sounds like a solid investment. Did you guys work out the travel logistics yet?

We started to. We actually discussed whether economy or business class should be booked for the Shenzhen trip, but we haven't locked that in yet. On a lighter note, Boss Zhang suggested trying the local dim sum during the Shenzhen trip.
You definitely can't skip the dim sum! Want me to start looking up some highly-rated spots near the studio you're visiting, or maybe pull up some suitcase options?
Just the suitcase options for now, please. I'll worry about the food once we actually get the flights sorted out.
You got it. I'll gather some durable, travel-friendly suitcase recommendations and send them your way shortly.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-08 Boss Zhang finalized the decision that Linchen will lead the Shenzhen trip next month.

messages.content: Hey, I just talked to Liwei about that Shenzhen trip Boss Zhang put me in charge of next month. Man, she got visibly upset when she realized it overlaps with our anniversary.
Ouch, that's rough. Anniversaries are a big deal. How did you handle it?
I tried to smooth things over and reassure her. I made a serious commitment to her that I will video call her every single night while I'm on the Shenzhen trip.
Good call. That should help show her she's still a priority, even when you're traveling. Did she calm down a bit after that?

A little. We started talking about the logistics to change the subject. I told her the flight duration for the trip is only about three hours. She also asked if the company is paying for all my meals while I'm there.
Classic question! I assume they are covering the standard per diem?

Yeah, standard expense policy. We also talked about the hotel rating for the accommodation down there, hoping it's a decent place. Anyway, I definitely need to remember to pack my noise-canceling headphones for the Shenzhen trip.
Will do! I'll add the noise-canceling headphones to your packing list. Hang in there with Liwei, you've got this.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-09 Liwei became visibly upset when she learned about the Shenzhen trip overlapping with their anniversary.
On 2025-07-09 Linchen made a serious commitment to Liwei to video call her every night during the Shenzhen trip.

messages.content: Hey, I just got off the phone with my Mom. We were catching up about that Shenzhen trip Boss Zhang has me leading next month.
Oh nice, how's she doing? Did she have any advice for the trip?
She's doing well. She actually mentioned her neighbor went to Shenzhen recently and complained non-stop about the traffic there.
Typical neighbor gossip! Are you flying or taking the train down there?
We actually discussed that. We debated high-speed rail versus flying, but I'm leaning toward flying since I told her the exact dates are in mid-August.
Makes sense for mid-August, flying is probably faster. Did she give you the usual mom reminders?
Of course she did. She reminded me to pack an umbrella since it'll probably rain a lot. Oh, and I promised her I'd buy her this specific silk scarf she's been wanting while I'm on the Shenzhen trip.
That's sweet of you! Just don't forget the scarf, or you'll never hear the end of it. Let me know if you need me to set a reminder for mid-August to go shopping.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-09 Linchen promised his Mom he would buy her a specific silk scarf during the Shenzhen trip.

messages.content: Hey, remind me to pack my sports gear tomorrow. Jiange and I just scheduled our badminton session for this Saturday at 10:00 AM.
Got it, I'll remind you to pack your gear tomorrow. Sounds like a fun Saturday morning!
Yeah, though I'm pretty annoyed right now. The shuttlecocks for the badminton session have gotten way too expensive lately. We burn through them so fast.
Inflation hitting everything, huh? Maybe you guys can find a bulk deal online to save some cash.

Maybe. Jiange actually mentioned his racket strings broke during our last badminton session, so he has to use his backup racket. We also spent half the morning debating which brand of grip tape is best for the badminton session.
Classic gear debates. Did you two finally agree on a brand, or is it still an ongoing rivalry?
We agreed to disagree. Anyway, Jiange is super excited about showing off his new shoes at the badminton session. Let's hope they actually help his footwork.
New shoes always add a little bounce! I've got your Saturday 10:00 AM badminton session with Jiange on the calendar. Have a great game!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-10 Jiange and Linchen scheduled the badminton session for Saturday at 10:00 AM.

messages.content: Hey, I'm just taking a quick breather at my desk. Sister Chen just came by while I was venting about the Q3 multiplayer crunch. I told her I was feeling immense relief because I'm using the badminton session tomorrow with Jiange to completely de-stress from work.
That sounds like exactly what you need! Escaping the server latency and multiplayer crunch for a bit of sports is a great way to reset. How did Sister Chen react?
She was super supportive. She actually asked if the badminton session is indoors or outdoors, just to see if we'd be dealing with the brutal summer heat.
Good question from her. Are you guys playing inside where there's AC?
Yeah, it's indoors. I mentioned to her that the court rental fee for the badminton session is 100 RMB per hour, which isn't too bad for a decent air-conditioned place.
Not bad at all for keeping cool! Did she have any other advice for your match?
Yeah, we actually joked about me pulling a muscle at the badminton session since I haven't played in a while. She also suggested bringing electrolyte drinks to the badminton session to stay hydrated.
She knows you too well! Definitely grab some sports drinks, and make sure you stretch so you don't actually pull anything tomorrow. Enjoy the stress relief!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-11 Linchen showed immense relief, telling Sister Chen he is using the badminton session to de-stress from work.

messages.content: Hey, I just got back from badminton with Jiange. I'm exhausted, but I need to organize some stuff for apartment hunting with Liwei.
Hope the badminton session helped you de-stress! What do you need to organize for the apartment hunt?

Well, we were discussing the commute times to the studio during the apartment hunting today, so I need to map those out. Also, Liwei mentioned a broker fee discount she found for the apartment hunting, so I should probably dig up that link she sent.
Got it, keeping commute times low is definitely a priority. I'll remind you to check that discount link. Any specific requirements for the new place?

Yeah, I noted that the apartment hunting involves looking at places with south-facing windows. Liwei really wants good sunlight. Honestly, the whole process is so tiring I joked that the apartment hunting is making me want to just live in a tent.
A tent might be a bit rough for the daily commute, though the rent is unbeatable! The south-facing windows sound lovely. Are you guys setting a deadline for all this?

Yeah, especially with my upcoming Shenzhen trip overlapping with our anniversary, I don't want this dragging on. I made a serious commitment to Liwei that we will finalize the apartment hunting by the end of July.
That's a solid plan. Finalizing it by the end of July will definitely give you both peace of mind before your trip. I'll make a note of that deadline for you.

golden_memories: On 2025-07-12 Linchen made a serious commitment to Liwei that they will finalize the apartment hunting by the end of July.

messages.content: I just had a weekend catch-up over tea with Sister Chen. We talked a lot about the apartment hunting Liwei and I are doing. Honestly, I expressed some deep anxiety to her today. The rent prices we're seeing out there are just insanely high, and it's really triggering my stress.
I can imagine how stressful that is, especially with the end-of-July deadline you promised Liwei. Did Sister Chen have any good advice or ways to help you manage the anxiety?

Yeah, she was great. She actually shared a really detailed checklist for the apartment hunting so we don't miss any red flags. I told her we already looked at three different neighborhoods this weekend, but it's tough finding a good fit.
At least you're covering ground by checking out those three neighborhoods. The checklist sounds like a handy tool to keep things organized and maybe make the process feel a bit more under control.
Definitely. We also discussed whether furnished or unfurnished places are better for the apartment hunting. Unfurnished might be cheaper on the rent, but buying all the furniture adds up fast.
That's a classic dilemma. Furnished saves time and upfront hassle, but unfurnished lets you make it your own. It's a lot to weigh while balancing the budget.
Exactly. But I feel a little better having a plan. Sister Chen even recommended a reliable moving company we can use once the apartment hunting is done. She's really thinking ahead for us.
Sister Chen sounds like an amazing friend to have in your corner right now. Just take it one step at a time, and don't let those rent prices overwhelm you!

golden_memories: On 2025-07-13 Linchen expressed deep anxiety to Sister Chen, triggered by the high rent prices seen during the apartment hunting.

messages.content: Hey, just got back from the badminton session with Jiange. We went pretty hard today, he even said his shoulder was a bit sore afterwards.
Sounds like an intense match! Hope his shoulder recovers quickly. Are you guys still planning to play next weekend?
Yeah, but we're changing the schedule. Jiange arranged for the next badminton session to be moved to Sunday at 2:00 PM instead of our usual Saturday morning slot.
Got it, I've updated your calendar for next Sunday at 2:00 PM. Anything else I should note for that day?

Well, I suggested grabbing hot pot after the next badminton session, since we'll be playing in the afternoon. Oh, and Jiange mentioned he needs to buy more sports socks before the badminton session next week.
Hot pot after a workout sounds like the perfect way to refuel! I can remind you to check if he got his socks later this week, if you'd like.
Nah, no need for that. We also talked about the parking situation near the venue for the badminton session—it was a total nightmare today, so I think I'll just take the subway next Sunday.
Good call on taking the subway. It definitely beats circling around looking for a spot. Let me know if you need me to pull up the transit route when the time comes!
